title: Training load — daily calendar
description: Daily training load (mart.daily_load) and per-session detail (mart.activity_wide). has_estimated_load and tss_method are shown explicitly: a load derived from heart rate (hr_hrtss) does not have the same status as a load measured from power or pace.

list.name: athlete_id
list.query: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id
list.definition: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id

panels.title: Daily TSS — measured vs estimated
panels.description: mart.daily_load.tss split by mart.daily_load.has_estimated_load. "TSS estimated (HR)" flags that at least one session of the day carries a load derived from heart rate (hr_hrtss or rpe method) instead of measured from power/pace/CSS — COMMENT ON MATERIALIZED VIEW mart.daily_load.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.local_date::timestamp AS time, CASE WHEN NOT d.has_estimated_load THEN d.tss END AS "TSS measured", CASE WHEN d.has_estimated_load THEN d.tss END AS "TSS estimated (HR)" FROM mart.daily_load d WHERE d.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(d.local_date) ORDER BY d.local_date

panels.title: Sessions in the period
panels.description: Per-session detail from mart.activity_wide. The "TSS method" (tss_method) column shows explicitly which method produced the canonical TSS (bike_power, run_power, run_gap, swim_css, hr_hrtss, rpe). The "IF method" column (migration 011) plays the same role for intensity: an IF derived from GAP is not read like an IF derived from power, and running goes through GAP for as long as rFTP stays NULL — COMMENT ON MATERIALIZED VIEW mart.activity_wide.

targets.rawSql: SELECT w.local_date AS "Date", w.sport AS "Sport", w.name AS "Session", w.duration_s AS "Duration (s)", w.distance_m AS "Distance (m)", w.tss AS "TSS", w.tss_method AS "TSS method", w.tss_hr AS "TSS (HR, comparison)", w.trimp AS "TRIMP", w.intensity_factor AS "IF", w.intensity_factor_method AS "IF method", w.decoupling_pct AS "Decoupling (%)", w.data_quality AS "Quality", w.needs_manual_rpe AS "Manual RPE required" FROM mart.activity_wide w WHERE $__timeFilter(w.local_date) ORDER BY w.local_date DESC
